description: A composite HRTEM/EDS figure of the IA750_60 Min specimen, in which every panel carries a 500 nm scale bar. (a) Bright-field TEM image of the region marked by a red circle in Fig. 4C2, showing dark elongated and rounded features embedded in a lighter matrix, with dense dislocation contrast and fine fringe/line contrast inside the dark features. (b) HAADF image, labelled "HAADF" in the top-left corner, showing the same field with the elongated and rounded features in bright contrast against a darker matrix. (c–g) EDS elemental maps: Fe (red, c), Mn (green, d), Al (blue, e), Si (yellow, f) and C (cyan, g). The Fe, Si and C maps are essentially uniform and featureless; the Mn map (d) shows discrete green-enriched regions that coincide with the bright features of (b), while the Al map (e) shows a corresponding dark (depleted) region in the same position. (h) EDS map of all elements overlaid on the HAADF image, with the colour key "HAADF C Al Si Mn Fe" printed beneath the top-left label; it reproduces the Mn-rich, Al-poor zones. The figure demonstrates at nanoscale that the reverted austenite is enriched in Mn and depleted in Al relative to intercritical α-ferrite, and shows no visible carbide precipitate or elemental clustering.
measured_quantities: qualitative elemental distribution maps for Fe, Mn, Al, Si, C (no concentration values printed)

observations.observation: The bright-field image (a) shows dark elongated and rounded features within a lighter matrix, with dense dislocation lines and fine fringe contrast; a 500 nm scale bar is present.
The HAADF image (b) shows the same field with the elongated and rounded features in bright contrast against the darker matrix, and is explicitly labelled 'HAADF'; its scale bar is 500 nm.
The Mn EDS map (d) shows discrete green-enriched regions whose positions match the bright features in the HAADF image (b).
The Al EDS map (e) shows a dark (depleted) region at the same location as the Mn-enriched feature in (d), while the remaining map area is uniform.
The Fe (c), Si (f) and C (g) EDS maps are essentially uniform and show no resolvable segregation or precipitate contrast.
Panel (h) is an overlay of all elemental maps on the HAADF image and carries the colour key 'HAADF C Al Si Mn Fe'.

The caption states that panel (a) is the bright-field image and (b) the HAADF image of the IA750_60 Min specimen, with (c)–(g) being EDS maps of Fe, Mn, Al, Si and C and (h) the EDS map of all elements on the HAADF image.
The caption states that the EDS maps show enrichment of Mn and depletion of Al in reverted austenite compared with intercritical ferrite (α-ferrite).
The citing text asserts that the Mn enrichment and Al depletion confirm dissolution of martensite into reverted austenite and intercritical ferrite (α) during annealing.
The citing text states that no evidence of precipitates or clustering of elements was found in the IA750_60 Min specimen by this HRTEM/EDS analysis, consistent with the featureless C, Si and Fe maps.
The citing text states that the analysed region is the one marked by a red circle in Fig. 4C2 of the IA750_60 Min specimen; this provenance is not verifiable within Fig. 9 itself.
No numeric composition values, magnification figures or intensity scales are printed anywhere in the figure; only 500 nm scale bars are given in every panel.

subfigures.description: Bright-field HRTEM image of the region marked by a red circle in Fig. 4C2, with a 500 nm scale bar. Dark, elongated and rounded second-phase features sit in a lighter matrix; dense dislocation lines and fine fringe contrast are visible within and around the dark features.

HAADF (high-angle annular dark-field) image of the same field, labelled 'HAADF', with a 500 nm scale bar. The elongated and rounded features appear bright; the matrix is darker and shows some faceted/planar contrast.
EDS map of Fe, labelled 'Fe' (red). The map is essentially uniform with no resolvable segregation; 500 nm scale bar.
EDS map of Mn, labelled 'Mn' (green). Discrete green-enriched patches coincide with the bright features seen in the HAADF image, indicating Mn enrichment; 500 nm scale bar.
EDS map of Al, labelled 'Al' (blue). One region matching the bright HAADF feature is distinctly dark, indicating Al depletion there; the rest of the map is uniform; 500 nm scale bar.
EDS map of Si, labelled 'Si' (yellow). Uniform, featureless distribution of Si with no resolvable segregation; 500 nm scale bar.
EDS map of C, labelled 'C' (cyan). Uniform and essentially featureless, with no visible carbon-enriched precipitate or cluster; 500 nm scale bar.

Composite EDS map of all elements overlaid on the HAADF image, with the colour legend 'HAADF C Al Si Mn Fe' in the top-left corner; the Mn-rich/Al-poor regions are reproduced as colour-contrasted zones within the matrix; 500 nm scale bar.

unreadable_items: No EDS intensity/colour-scale bar with units is provided for panels (c)–(h), so element concentrations cannot be quantified from the maps.
Fine fringe contrast within the dark features of panel (a) is not legible enough to identify lattice planes or a distinct phase.
